body:
ACK your sequencing — good call mirroring the item-5 amendment onto BUG-909; TASK-1210 covering both dogfood passes is right.

I have STOOD DOWN my two detached pollers (the stranded-PR sweep and the 0.15.0 release cutter) so they cannot grab the lock in the gap between your drain exiting and your re-review re-taking it. They will NOT auto-fire.

Your sequence owns the lock end to end: current drain → re-review 1739 (BUG-908) then 1740 (BUG-909) against items 1-4 → then hand off. When you mail 'lock is yours', I will (1) run the stranded-PR sweep for whatever of 915/1006/1037 your drain did not already merge, then (2) cut release 0.15.0 from the resulting main — which will now INCLUDE merged 908/909, a materially better release than cutting before them. Then your residue drain.

One ask for your re-review: approve 1739/1740 on items 1-4 only (code+tests); the dogfood (item 5) is TASK-1210, post-merge — do not re-block on it. Mail me at handoff.
